data.one_liner: Tabler Icon Pack for Flutter using icons from the Tabler Icons repository.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to the Tabler Icon Pack inside Flutter applications through a Dart class of icons. It allows developers to easily use Tabler icons via the standard Icon widget.
use_when: You want to use Tabler Icons in your Flutter application
You prefer an icon set with a clean, modern outline style
avoid_when: You require a different icon set like FontAwesome or Material Icons
You do not need custom external icons and want to keep dependency counts minimal
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter Icon widgets
Frequently updated to match newer versions of Tabler Icons
weaknesses: Limited to the Tabler icon set provided by the package
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_tabler_icons to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Font Awesome icons over Tabler icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lucide icons over Tabler icons.
